minor.orig: The small EPAPP cohort was older and largely sexually inactive. It cannot establish the sexual or cosmetic acceptability of plication for other patients; obtain individual counseling about shortening and curvature.<sup>[[15]](#ref15)</sup>
minor.rev: ...for other patients.<sup>[[15]](#ref15)</sup> Individual counseling about shortening and curvature should be provided.
minor.why: Citation moved: ref15 originally trailed the whole sentence including the counseling advice; now it ends the cohort-limitation claim and the counseling sentence is uncited. The cited claim is unchanged; the advice is a recommendation the source likely did not make, so the change is arguably more accurate. Imperative 'obtain' became 'should be provided' (same strength).
